name: 污水危机：起源 Sewage Crisis: Origins
detailed_description:
Sewage Crisis: Origins

 is a first person horror game adapted from human experimentation. The game story takes place in an abandoned hospital deep in the mountains. Players will feel the enthusiasm of the villagers, the warmth of the hospital, and the beauty of the world in the game. Experience firsthand the spine chilling human experiment event, there are some things that cannot be forgotten.

Background of the story

You were deceived and thrown into the deep mountains, and by chance, you discovered this hospital. The hospital hidden in the deep mountains has unknown secrets. What is the fate of those who were deceived and captured? What is hidden behind the blood? As clues are found one after another, the truth gradually emerges. Can you empathize with the pain of those who experienced it at that time? And these are just the tip of the iceberg to the best of my ability

Gameplay

 You need to do your best to cross the deep mountains, enter that hospital, explore the abandoned hospital, find clues, collect key items, unravel the shocking secrets buried in the hospital one by one, and finally piece together the truth behind it. However, when you discover the ultimate truth, the biggest danger also comes. Don't look back, run away!

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
